judgeIssues.detail: A translator/pipeline annotation "[uncertain: bonding curve]" leaked into the target text; it is content not present in the source and would ship to users (addition). Keeping "bonding curve" in English is itself acceptable per the vi-VN crypto-register policy (no established native term), but the bracketed note must be removed.

evidence.targetSpan: Ra mắt qua Pools.xyz. [uncertain: bonding curve]
